answer: The strongest single control I know for this is EMG forearm muscle signal profile, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A sonnet of doubt is healthy, a spiral of proof is required, and a vertex of patience is the price of a clean panel. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
